svg.aria-label: A continuous ink drawing for Yemen. A single firm line — a salary — enters from the left at mid-page and stops abruptly, fraying into short falling dashes. Where it breaks, the line's height is carried on by a relay of overlapping horizontal strokes stacked like planks: a fine dashed stratum above, a row of short firm segments below, a faint sagging thread beneath them all. Holding the exact height of the lost line, one kiln-orange plank — the audited payment layer, the only warm mark on the page — ends in a small upright tick well before the right edge: a closing date. Beyond it the fainter strata run on alone, thinning toward the edge of the page.
svg.title: The Still · Yemen — a payroll line that stops, and the layers that carry its height
svg.desc: One firm ink line enters from the left edge at the middle of the page: the salary. Just left of centre it stops, its end fraying into three short dashes that fall away. From the break onward, the height of the lost line is held by a relay of horizontal strata drawn one above another like overlapping planks: above, a fine dashed line — help in kind, community and produce; below, a row of short firm segments with gaps between them — allowances decreed one governorate at a time; beneath them all, a faint thread that sags as it runs — the teacher's own labour, resold. At the exact height of the broken payroll runs the strongest mark on the right half of the page: a single kiln-orange plank, the audited payment layer, the only warm thing on the page. It ends at a small upright tick — a closing date — well before the right edge. Past the tick the orange does not resume; the fainter ink strata run on alone and thin toward the edge. No fills, no volumes; the line is the image; the ground is paper-cream.
